label: Intake agent
text: This is the claims intake desk. Please give your name and tell me which incident you are calling about.

label: Caller
text: I work at Willow Harbor Supply. My incident was at Cedar Dock, loading bay three. The report number ends in 42.

label: Intake agent
text: Thank you. Could you give me the name on the report and the date, if you remember it?

label: Caller
text: My name is River Ellis. I think it was Monday, but it might have been Tuesday. I would need to check my shift record.

label: Caller
text: I can take a call after my shift to confirm the date. Please attach my message to the Cedar Dock report.

label: Intake agent
text: I have taken your message. An examiner will check the report details and follow up.
